posts.coverText: 5 risky questions to ask your gf

slideText.text: If you had to erase one memory of me, which would it be?
Would you choose me or your best friend in a crisis?
Which ex taught you the most about love?
What's a secret fantasy you haven't told me?
What's something about me you're scared to admit?
What's something you hope we never stop doing, no matter how long we're together?
What's one truth about love you're still trying to understand?
What's something you've never said because you weren't sure how I'd take it?
When do you feel the most connected to us, not just me, but us?
What part of yourself feels the most loved when you're with me?
What's one thing you want us to protect as we grow, no matter how life changes?
What's one emotional need you have that I might not fully understand yet?
When do you feel the strongest sense of 'us', and what creates it?
What hard truth should we talk about now before it becomes a problem?
What's something we handle well now that we didn't in the beginning, and why did we grow there?

posts.coverText: 5 deep questions to ask your bf today

slideText.text: What is a secret passion you'd love to explore together?
Which flaw of mine do you adore?
When did you first feel truly safe with me?
What adventure do you dream of for us in 10 years?
If we could create a couple's ritual, what would it be?

posts.coverText: 5 playful 'would you rather' questions to ask your partner

slideText.text: Would you rather have breakfast in bed or a picnic in the park?
Would you rather dance in the rain or sunbathe on the rooftop?
Would you rather binge-watch comedies or have a dance-off all night?
Would you rather cook a messy pasta dinner or bake cookies together?
Would you rather cuddle under a blanket fort or stargaze from the balcony?

posts.coverText: 5 trick questions to ask your bf

slideText.text: If I disappeared for a week, where would I be?
What's my hidden talent?
Guess my biggest irrational fear?
If we switched lives, what's the first thing I'd do?
What's my spirit animal?

posts.coverText: 5 rage bait questions for your bf

slideText.text: If I asked you to choose between me and your video games right now, which would you pick?
Do you think I'm jealous when I ask you who you're texting?
Are you still talking to your ex?
Why don't you ever notice when I change my hair?
Do you care more about your friends than me?

posts.coverText: 5 questions that make him think about you all night

slideText.text: When did you first realize you felt something deeper for me?
What's something about me that you think about more than you admit?
What's one moment with me you wish you could relive tonight?
What's something you want to tell me, but only when it's late and quiet?
What's one thing you hope I never stop doing, even years from now?
